source.title: Some Open Problems in Complex Singularities

trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as a single zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 7005181.

Local workflow shard metadata identified zbMATH 7005181 as the 2018 Springer chapter Some Open Problems in Complex Singularities, DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-73639-6_14. Springer and UNAM metadata pages corroborated the title, author José Seade, host volume, and pages 433-456, but those pages did not expose the chapter problem statements as readable technical source text.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus paywalled_or_restricted, metadata_only, and network_or_dns_failure. Local shell fetches could not resolve zbmath.org or api.zbmath.org. Browser fetches of the zbMATH resolver and Springer chapter did not provide readable full text. The Springer book page and UNAM author page exposed bibliographic metadata/table-of-contents information only. The ResearchGate full-book candidate was advertised as a PDF but was not readable through the available tools, and the searchable preview exposed only front matter and table-of-contents text. No exact-work readable PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered, so extraction was not attempted.
